rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: On the CEC protocol of 23 March 2018 (73,578,992 voters took part), the CEC declares the election of the President "called for 18 March 2018" valid and deems Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin elected President of the Russian Federation with 56,430,712 votes (76.69 per cent), more than half of those voting; publication ordered in the CEC Vestnik (print and online) and Rossiyskaya gazeta. Signed E. A. Pamfilova (Chairman) and M. V. Grishina (Secretary), 23 March 2018, No. 152/1255-7.
